WinRAR_PluginDesc: WinRAR integration plugin. Lets Lertaro fill in the destination path in WinRAR's Extract dialog (e.g. from the Quick Navigation menu).
Plugin_Comp_Desc_WinRARExtractDialogAdap: Detects WinRAR's "Extract path and options" dialog by its control structure (not window title, since WinRAR is localized) and lets Lertaro fill in its destination path field.
